image_description: A low-angle shot of a traffic light assembly against a cloudy sky. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal head mounted on a horizontal cantilever arm attached to a vertical pole. The signal head appears damaged or malformed, with the top section looking melted or broken. A red light is illuminated. There is a secondary square sign below the main signal. In the background, there are trees, buildings, and utility poles.
